improvements: Refreshed the full slab outline at centimetre precision.
Source polygon collision now preserves its angled end geometry.
Lighter blue glass (#56778f), and the south-east end is now grey bands between ribbon windows (still square-ended), from the official panorama at 44.450804, 26.088191 heading 315.
remainingGaps: The source maps 14 levels but no height; the 56 m wedge and 44/46 m body/plant levels remain prior estimates.
End assignment, tenant sign placement and detailed glazing grid need further independent confirmation.
Neighbour overlap, terrain support and tourist-scene context need the separate district/scene pass; isolated model pictures do not establish complete parity.
Glass colour and band proportions are estimates; panorama viewed as reference only; not stored or published.
